<!--
Project hrt-survival of the BCPP repository. This file is the only analysis
file for this project. It is based on Xiaoman's R script (BCPP_final10.27.R)
and her Rmd of 2026-10-19, but starts from the shared BCPP cleaning
(R/build_bcpp_base.R) and the raw files via config/config.R, so that no
hand-made intermediate files are needed. Knit it from the RStudio project
(BCPP.Rproj) so that here::here() finds the repository root.

Differences with Xiaoman's version, see the README of this project:
* the cohort is built from the raw files (no merged_final10.27.xlsx);
* missing values are real NA, not the text "NA";
* tumour size and tumour number are compared as numbers;
* every Cox model and Kaplan-Meier table is produced in one run, for all
  women and for NMIBC and MIBC, so nothing has to be switched by hand;
* the Model 2 results table of the MIBC DFS analysis uses Model 2.
-->

# Packages and shared data

```{r packages}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(rms)
library(knitr)
```

```{r shared-data}
# Shared cleaning for all BCPP papers (see docs/04_cleaning_decisions.md).
# Result: `bcpp_base`, one row per participant, no rows dropped. Times are in years.
source(here::here("R", "build_bcpp_base.R"))
```

# Cohort

Women with bladder cancer and known HRT status (`52_hrt` is 1 = yes or 2 = no;
0, 3 = unknown, 99 and missing are left out).

```{r cohort}
meds <- read_csv(find_data_file("q1_medications.csv", bcpp_data_dir),
                 show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(unique_id,
            hrt_raw  = `52_hrt`,
            pill_raw = `52_contraceptive_pill`)

hist_q1 <- read_csv(find_data_file("q1_medical_history.csv", bcpp_data_dir),
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(unique_id,
            successful_pregnancies,
            not_stopped_menstruation = `not stopped menstruation`)

women <- bcpp_base %>%
  filter(Gender == "female", bladder_ca == "Yes") %>%
  left_join(meds,    by = "unique_id") %>%
  left_join(hist_q1, by = "unique_id")

flow <- tibble(
  step = c("Women with bladder cancer",
           "Known HRT status (analysis cohort)"),
  n    = c(nrow(women), sum(women$hrt_raw %in% c(1, 2)))
)
kable(flow)

d <- women %>%
  filter(hrt_raw %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  transmute(
    unique_id,
    age_at_recruit,
    Ethnicity,
    X52_hrt = factor(ifelse(hrt_raw == 1, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    X52_contraceptive_pill = factor(pill_raw, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Yes", "No")),
    X21_currently_smoke = factor(
      recode(as.character(smoke_status), Current = "Yes", Former = "Used to", Never = "Never"),
      levels = c("Yes", "Used to", "Never")),
    grade,
    grade_grouped = factor(
      case_when(grade %in% c("Grade_1", "Grade_2") ~ "Grade_1+2",
                grade == "Grade_3"                 ~ "Grade_3"),
      levels = c("Grade_1+2", "Grade_3")),
    stage, stage_group = as.character(stage_group),
    TNM_Nodes, TNM_Mets,
    number_tumours, size_largest_tumour,
    size_cat = factor(case_when(size_largest_tumour <  3 ~ "<3",
                                size_largest_tumour >= 3 ~ ">=3"),
                      levels = c("<3", ">=3")),
    cat_tumournumber = factor(case_when(number_tumours <  2 ~ "<2",
                                        number_tumours >= 2 ~ ">=2"),
                              levels = c("<2", ">=2")),
    # successful_pregnancies: 88, 99 and 999 = unknown
    successful_pregnancy_binary = case_when(
      successful_pregnancies %in% c(88, 99, 999) ~ NA_character_,
      successful_pregnancies >  0 ~ "Had successful pregnancy",
      successful_pregnancies == 0 ~ "No successful pregnancy"),
    not_stopped_menstruation,
    # Overall survival: death from any cause (time in years from the survival file)
    # The shared cleaning converts days to years with 365; Xiaoman's OS times use 365.25.
    # The 365.25 is kept so that the medians and 5-year rates of the manuscript do not change
    # (differences are at most 0.006 years).
    time_to_overall_survival = time_to_overall_survival * 365 / 365.25,
    Mortality_status_numeric = event,
    # Disease-free survival: death or recurrence/progression (recurrence_with_progression,
    # defined by Birmingham), time in years
    DFSstatus = if_else(event == 1 | recurrence_with_progression %in% 1, 1, 0),
    time_rwp  = time_to_recurrence_with_progression / 365,
    DFStimeyears = if_else(DFSstatus == 1,
                           coalesce(time_rwp, time_to_overall_survival),
                           pmin(time_rwp, time_to_overall_survival, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

stopifnot(nrow(d) == 239, sum(d$X52_hrt == "Yes") == 70)
table(HRT = d$X52_hrt, useNA = "ifany")
```

# Table 1: baseline characteristics by HRT use

Counts are n (%) of all women (Total) and within the HRT and non-HRT groups. Where a row
"Unknown" is shown, the test includes it as a category (grade, parity, contraceptive
pill, tumour number); stage, nodes, metastasis, tumour size and ethnicity are tested on
known values only.

```{r table1-helpers}
# n (%) of a categorical variable: Total, HRT, Non-HRT (unknown shown as "Unknown")
cat_table <- function(x, label) {
  x <- addNA(factor(x), ifany = TRUE)
  levels(x)[is.na(levels(x))] <- "Unknown"
  tab <- table(x, d$X52_hrt)
  pct <- function(n, N) sprintf("%d (%.2f)", n, 100 * n / N)
  data.frame(
    Variable = label, Level = rownames(tab),
    Total    = mapply(pct, rowSums(tab), nrow(d)),
    HRT      = mapply(pct, tab[, "Yes"], sum(d$X52_hrt == "Yes")),
    `Non-HRT`= mapply(pct, tab[, "No"],  sum(d$X52_hrt == "No")),
    check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
}
p_fmt <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))
```

```{r table1}
# Age
age_row <- d %>% group_by(X52_hrt) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median = median(age_at_recruit), Q1 = quantile(age_at_recruit, .25),
            Q3 = quantile(age_at_recruit, .75), mean = mean(age_at_recruit), sd = sd(age_at_recruit))
age_all <- c(median = median(d$age_at_recruit), Q1 = quantile(d$age_at_recruit, .25)[[1]],
             Q3 = quantile(d$age_at_recruit, .75)[[1]])
kable(age_row, digits = 2, caption = "Age at diagnosis, by HRT use")
cat(sprintf("All women: median %.2f (IQR %.2f-%.2f)\n", age_all[1], age_all[2], age_all[3]))
shapiro.test(d$age_at_recruit)
wilcox.test(age_at_recruit ~ X52_hrt, data = d)

# Tests, in the order of the manuscript
chisq_p  <- function(...) suppressWarnings(chisq.test(table(...)))$p.value
fisher_p <- function(...) fisher.test(table(...))$p.value
unk <- function(x) { x <- addNA(factor(x), ifany = TRUE); x }   # unknown as a category

nodes_group <- case_when(d$TNM_Nodes == "N0" ~ "No metastasis",
                         d$TNM_Nodes %in% c("N1", "N2") ~ "Metastasis")

table1 <- bind_rows(
  cbind(cat_table(d$Ethnicity,  "Ethnicity"),   P = p_fmt(fisher_p(d$Ethnicity, d$X52_hrt))),
  cbind(cat_table(d$X21_currently_smoke, "Smoking"), P = p_fmt(chisq_p(d$X21_currently_smoke, d$X52_hrt))),
  cbind(cat_table(ifelse(d$not_stopped_menstruation, "No", "Yes"), "Menopause"),
        P = p_fmt(fisher_p(d$not_stopped_menstruation, d$X52_hrt))),
  cbind(cat_table(d$successful_pregnancy_binary, "Parity"),
        P = p_fmt(chisq_p(unk(d$successful_pregnancy_binary), d$X52_hrt))),
  cbind(cat_table(d$X52_contraceptive_pill, "Contraceptive pill"),
        P = p_fmt(chisq_p(unk(d$X52_contraceptive_pill), d$X52_hrt))),
  cbind(cat_table(d$stage_group, "Cancer type"), P = p_fmt(chisq_p(d$stage_group, d$X52_hrt))),
  cbind(cat_table(d$TNM_Nodes,   "Nodes (N)"),  P = p_fmt(fisher_p(nodes_group, d$X52_hrt))),
  cbind(cat_table(d$TNM_Mets,    "Metastasis (M)"), P = p_fmt(fisher_p(d$TNM_Mets, d$X52_hrt))),
  cbind(cat_table(d$grade,       "Grade"),      P = p_fmt(chisq_p(unk(d$grade), d$X52_hrt))),
  cbind(cat_table(d$size_cat,    "Tumour size (cm)"), P = p_fmt(chisq_p(d$size_cat, d$X52_hrt))),
  cbind(cat_table(d$cat_tumournumber, "Tumour numbers"),
        P = p_fmt(chisq_p(d$cat_tumournumber, d$X52_hrt)))
)
kable(table1, caption = "Table 1 (the P value is shown on every row of a variable)")
```

# Kaplan-Meier analysis

```{r km-functions}
strata <- list(All = d, NMIBC = filter(d, stage_group %in% "NMIBC"),
               MIBC = filter(d, stage_group %in% "MIBC"))

km_table <- function(data, time, event, label) {
  f   <- as.formula(sprintf("Surv(%s, %s) ~ X52_hrt", time, event))
  fit <- survfit(f, data = data)
  tb  <- summary(fit)$table
  s5  <- summary(fit, times = 5, extend = TRUE)
  p   <- 1 - pchisq(survdiff(f, data = data)$chisq, 1)
  data.frame(Analysis = label, HRT = c("No", "Yes"),
             N = tb[, "records"], Events = tb[, "events"],
             Median = round(tb[, "median"], 2), Median_lcl = round(tb[, "0.95LCL"], 2),
             Median_ucl = round(tb[, "0.95UCL"], 2),
             Surv5y_pct = round(100 * s5$surv, 2), Surv5y_lcl = round(s5$lower, 2),
             Surv5y_ucl = round(s5$upper, 2), Logrank_p = round(p, 3), row.names = NULL)
}
```

```{r km-tables}
km_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(strata), function(s) {
    bind_rows(km_table(strata[[s]], "time_to_overall_survival", "Mortality_status_numeric", paste(s, "OS")),
              km_table(strata[[s]], "DFStimeyears", "DFSstatus", paste(s, "DFS")))
  }))
kable(km_all, caption = "Kaplan-Meier: events, median and 5-year survival (Tables S2-S7)")
```

```{r km-plots, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
for (s in names(strata)) {
  for (end in c("OS", "DFS")) {
    tm <- if (end == "OS") "time_to_overall_survival" else "DFStimeyears"
    ev <- if (end == "OS") "Mortality_status_numeric" else "DFSstatus"
    f  <- as.formula(sprintf("Surv(%s, %s) ~ X52_hrt", tm, ev))
    fit <- surv_fit(f, data = strata[[s]])
    print(ggsurvplot(fit, data = strata[[s]], pval = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE,
                     risk.table = TRUE, legend.title = "HRT use", palette = "Set1",
                     title = paste(end, "-", s),
                     xlab = if (end == "OS") "Time to death (years)" else "Time to events (years)",
                     ylab = if (end == "OS") "Overall survival probability" else "DFS probability"))
  }
}
```

# Cox regression

Model 1: HRT, smoking, age (restricted cubic spline, 3 knots) and contraceptive pill.
Model 2: Model 1 plus tumour grade (1+2 versus 3) and, in the analysis of all women,
cancer type (NMIBC/MIBC). The models use complete cases.

```{r cox}
cox_models <- function(data, time, event, stratified) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  dd <<- datadist(data); options(datadist = "dd")
  base <- sprintf("Surv(%s, %s) ~ X52_hrt + X21_currently_smoke + rcs(age_at_recruit, 3) + X52_contraceptive_pill",
                  time, event)
  add2 <- if (stratified) " + grade_grouped" else " + grade_grouped + stage_group"
  lapply(c(`Model 1` = base, `Model 2` = paste0(base, add2)), function(fm) {
    cph(as.formula(fm), data = data, x = TRUE, y = TRUE, surv = TRUE)
  })
}
hrt_row <- function(mod, label) {
  b <- coef(mod)[["X52_hrt=Yes"]]; se <- sqrt(vcov(mod)["X52_hrt=Yes", "X52_hrt=Yes"])
  data.frame(Analysis = label, N = mod$stats[["Obs"]], Events = mod$stats[["Events"]],
             HR = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", exp(b), exp(b - 1.96 * se), exp(b + 1.96 * se)),
             P = round(2 * pnorm(-abs(b / se)), 3),
             PH_global_p = round(cox.zph(mod)$table["GLOBAL", "p"], 3), row.names = NULL)
}

cox_fits <- list()
for (s in names(strata)) {
  for (end in c("OS", "DFS")) {
    tm <- if (end == "OS") "time_to_overall_survival" else "DFStimeyears"
    ev <- if (end == "OS") "Mortality_status_numeric" else "DFSstatus"
    cox_fits[[paste(s, end)]] <- cox_models(strata[[s]], tm, ev, stratified = s != "All")
  }
}
cox_table <- bind_rows(lapply(names(cox_fits), function(k) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(cox_fits[[k]]), function(m) hrt_row(cox_fits[[k]][[m]], paste(k, m))))
}))
kable(cox_table, caption = "HRT versus no HRT: hazard ratios (Tables 2 and 3) and global proportional hazards test")
```

## Full output of the models

```{r cox-full}
for (k in names(cox_fits)) for (m in names(cox_fits[[k]])) {
  cat("\n=====", k, m, "=====\n")
  print(cox_fits[[k]][[m]])
}
```

## Multicollinearity (VIF), Model 2 in all women

```{r vif}
round(vif(cox_fits[["All OS"]][["Model 2"]]), 2)
```

The two age spline terms are expected to be correlated with each other; the other
covariates have VIF below 2.
